entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Lisa Holm, a 17-year-old girl from Skövde working in Blomberg in Götene Municipality, Sweden, disappeared on 7 June 2015 and her body was found days later in a workshed. Her disappearance, the search for her, and the trial and conviction of Nerijus Bilevičius for her murder received widespread media attention in Sweden and Scandinavia.
